jobDescription.name: JOIN OUR TEAM
jobDescription.value: As Team Lead Mobile, you will lead our Mobile team in delivering our beautifully designed iOS and Android apps. With a strong understanding of both current and future business needs, you will take ownership of delivering new features and enhancements. Your leadership will foster the team’s growth through mentorship and the continuous optimisation of workflows and processes. This position is permanent and based in Munich.

jobDescription.name: WHAT YOU'LL DO
jobDescription.value:
• Work closely with your Product Manager, taking ownership of technology to execute the product strategy while ensuring a high-quality user experience
  • Mentor mobile apps engineers, supporting their growth and career development
  • Oversee the team’s delivery by planning and scoping engineering work, ensuring commitments are met and collaborating effectively with stakeholders
  • Continuously refine the team’s workflows and processes to enhance efficiency and effectiveness through ongoing optimisation

jobDescription.name: YOU COME WITH
jobDescription.value:
• Proven experience leading a mobile apps development team with a strong track record of mentoring and supporting engineers in their professional growth
  • Deep knowledge of mobile apps architecture and design patterns
  • Strong expertise in Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS frameworks and ecosystem and solid understanding of Android development, including Kotlin and the Android frameworks and ecosystem
  • A product-driven approach to engineering, ensuring technical decisions directly support overarching business goals
  • Expertise in leveraging and integrating Agentic AI into engineering workflows to radically accelerate the software development lifecycle
  • Fluency in English

jobDescription.name: WHY WESTWING
jobDescription.value:
If you are looking for a place where ambition meets creativity, where ideas turn into impact fast, and where people are trusted to grow - you have found it.
At Westwing, we’re building the Superbrand in Design with a team that’s shaping the future of beautiful home & living.

Here is what you can look forward to:

• A high-performance culture built on trust, feedback and collaboration
• An inspiring, international environment that empowers you to think big, take ownership, and grow beyond your comfort zone
• In-Office Culture: 4 office days per week (Mon-Thu) dedicated to fast decision-making, high-impact collaboration, and strong team connections
• Professionally equipped workstation of your personal choice
• A competitive compensation package including salary, benefits, and equity 
• 30 days of paid holiday to rest, recharge, and come back ready to create
• A beautiful, centrally located, dog-friendly office with inspiring spaces, a sunny terrace, and good food - designed for moments that energise and connect
• Exclusive discounts: 40% off Westwing Collection, 20% off third-party brands (each on non-reduced items), and 20% Family & Friends discount on Westwing Collection, plus special-occasion vouchers
• Wellbeing support through mental health resources, sports memberships, and preventive care
• Sustainable mobility options with discounted public transport and JobRad - moving with purpose and care for the planet
• Support for working parents, including our on-site Westwing Wichtel daycare and a partnership with multilingual provider Elly & Stoffl
• One annual Social Impact Day to give back to a cause you care about - because being human is our true superpower
• Team rituals that celebrate results and togetherness - from Summer & Winter Parties to Oktoberfest

jobDescription.name: ABOUT US
jobDescription.value:
Westwing, Europe’s #1 in Beautiful Living e-commerce, is present in 20+ European countries and achieved a GMV (Gross Merchandise Volume) of EUR 507 million in 2025. As Europe’s premium one-stop destination for Design Lovers, it offers a unique brand experience with a carefully curated assortment of the Westwing Collection and 3rd party design brands. The integrated platform combines Shop, Daily Specials, Stores, the B2B Service (Westwing Business) and the Westwing Design Service. Westwing’s team works together on its shared purpose to “Excite people to create homes that unlock the full beauty of life”. Founded in 2011, Westwing is headquartered in Munich and went public on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in October 2018.

Our team is a diverse group of professionals aiming for high performance, working together at a fast pace in an inspiring, international and informal environment that enables you to grow your career while working with a brand and products our customers love. We’re made up of passionate people who are creative enough to disrupt the status quo, brave enough to fail and smart enough to win. So come, be part of the “wow, you work at Westwing?” crowd.

Diversity is deeply rooted in our culture. Our mission doesn’t stop to inspire only your design choices, it continues to embrace an inclusive lifestyle filled with respect to everyone’s uniqueness, cultural differences and equal opportunity.

jobDescription.name: JOIN OUR TEAM
jobDescription.value: Als Legal Operations & Compliance Manager unterstützt du unser Legal Team in unserem Headquarter in München beim Aufbau einer innovativen Legal & Compliance Tech-Organisation und begleitest spannende (Wachstums-)Projekte. Du fungierst dabei als Legal Business Partner auf Augenhöhe mit anderen Unternehmensbereichen. Diese Position ist zunächst befristet auf 1,5 Jahre, der Arbeitsort ist München.

jobDescription.name: WHAT YOU'LL DO
jobDescription.value:
• Überwachung und Optimierung von rechtlichen und compliance-relevanten Unternehmensprozessen sowie von Legal-KPIs, einschließlich Legal easy GRC und Legal-KPI-Tracking für die CSRD-Berichterstattung
  • Schaffung effizienter Workflows z.B. im Contract-Lifecycle-Tool, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den operativen Business-Bereichen
  • Rechtliches Projektmanagement von Sonderprojekten wie Expansionen, Restrukturierungen oder neuen Geschäftsmodellen unter smarter Anwendung von Projektmanagement-Tools und KI sowie die Koordination externer Berater
  • Unterstützung des Legal-Teams bei der effektiven digitalen Standardisierung von Verträgen, bei der Einführung von Compliance-Chatbots, Legal-Tech-Triage und automatisierten KI-Agenten (einschließlich Vertragsbearbeitung, Dokumentenerstellung und Überwachung regulatorischer Anforderungen)
  • Implementierung eines State-of-the-Art Legal-Budget- & Invoicing-Tools zur fachübergreifenden Kostentransparenz
  • Smartes Litigation- und Insurance-Management sowie halbautomatisiertes Reporting gegenüber der Finanzabteilung und Abschlussprüfern
  • Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung relevanter konzernstrategischer Themen wie der KI-Transformation und dem IP-Research

jobDescription.name: YOU COME WITH
jobDescription.value:
• Mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in einer IT-Beratung, einem Legal-Tech-Unternehmen oder als Legal Operations Manager bei einem Wirtschaftsunternehmen 
  • Einem erfolgreich absolvierten Studium im Bereich (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder einer vergleichbaren Qualifikation
  • Idealerweise juristische Vorkenntnisse, z.B. als deutscher Wirtschaftsjurist oder belegt durch einen juristischen Abschluss einer angelsächsischen Rechtsordnung oder einer praktischen Tätigkeit bei einer Rechtsanwaltskanzlei
  • Fließende Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse
  • Echte Begeisterung für den Bereich Legal Tech und Verständnis für effizientes Legal Service Management als einen der Treiber für die Skalierung
  • Eine proaktive Herangehensweise, mit der du stets den Status quo hinterfragst und aktiv gestaltest
  • Eine pragmatische, lösungsorientierte sowie strukturierte und selbstständige  Arbeitsweise, sowohl alleine als auch im Team
  • Eine rasche Auffassungsgabe, mit der du selbst komplexe Prozesse in klare einzelne Schritte unterteilst, simplifizierst und die Optimierung prägnant sowie verständlich darstellst

We are building a pool of talented translators to support future opportunities across our international markets. This is an open call for candidates with specific language skills who are interested in upcoming freelance or temporary translation projects. If you’d like to be considered for upcoming roles in our Translation Talent Pool, we look forward to receiving your application.

jobDescription.name: JOIN OUR TEAM
jobDescription.value: As a Operations Manager at Westwing, you will direct all daily distribution centre operations across our warehouse departments, focusing on resource capacity, inventory accuracy and a proactive safety culture. In this strategic and impact-driven role, you will thrive in a fast-paced environment where your communication and crisis-management skills will drive team growth and operational excellence during peak surges. You will act with ownership and pace to lead your area and elevate our operational standards, contributing directly to our vision of becoming the Superbrand in Design. This position is unlimited and based in Robakowo.

jobDescription.name: WHAT YOU'LL DO
jobDescription.value:
• Direct and optimise all daily warehouse operations, ensuring seamless end-to-end execution across both Inbound (receiving, put-away, cross-docking) and Outbound (picking, packing, staging, shipping) departments
  • Forecast and manage labour, space and equipment requirements based on supply chain fluctuations to maintain optimal throughput and eliminate bottlenecks
  • Ensure strict inventory control and accuracy in collaboration with inventory teams, minimising shrinkage and maximising slotting efficiency through cycle counting schedules
  • Establish, monitor and elevate operational metrics and KPIs, including Inbound Dock-to-Stock time, Order Fill Rate, Picking/Packing accuracy and Cost Per Unit (CPU)
  • Mentor and develop a large, multi-shift team of supervisors, leads and associates, fostering a culture of high performance, accountability and open communication
  • Enforce strict compliance with local safety regulations (EHS) and corporate standards, actively driving a proactive, "zero-incident" safety culture
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives (Lean, Six Sigma, 5S) to eliminate waste, optimise layout design and successfully integrate automation or warehouse technologies

jobDescription.name: YOU COME WITH
jobDescription.value:
• 4+ years of progressive leadership experience in a high-volume, fast-paced distribution centre or warehouse environment
  • A proven track record of concurrently managing both high-volume Inbound and Outbound operations
  • Exceptional data literacy and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex warehouse metrics, manage labour management systems (LMS) and adjust staffing models in real time
  • Proven change and crisis-management skills, with the ability to navigate peak season surges, system transitions and supply chain disruptions with high emotional intelligence and decisive action
  • Strategic communication skills and strong interpersonal abilities to effectively align front-line floor workers with executive leadership
  • Fluency in both English and Polish (written and spoken) is required
